info.name: CollERP API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the CollERP Educational Institute ERP backend.

Covers every REST and GraphQL endpoint (~183 requests). See postman/CollERP.*.postman_env.json for role-specific environments (super_admin, admin, student). The collection-level pre-request script auto-refreshes `authToken` by hitting `POST /auth/login` whenever the token is missing or expired, so you only need to fill in `loginEmail` / `loginPassword` on the environment.

request.description: Authenticate and return a JWT. Public endpoint.

exec: pm.test('Response has token', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data ? j.data.token : j.token).to.be.a('string'); });
try { const j = pm.response.json(); const t = (j.data && j.data.token) || j.token; if (t) pm.environment.set('authToken', t); } catch(e) {}
